answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 159443 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: My father died and left 4 son's 1 daughter 1 wife. How to distribute the property? Question: My father died and left 4 son's 1 daughter 1 wife. How to distribute the property? Answer ID: 159443 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 670/585/M=6/1439) In the above mentioned case, all the property of your deceased father shall be divided into 72 shares after paying due rights preceding inheritance. Out of the total, the widow of the deceased i.e. your mother shall get 9 shares, while 14-14 shares shall go to each brother (i.e. sons) while the sister (i.e. daughter) shall get 7 shares. The detail of Shariah division is as follows: Wife: 1 x 09 = 09 Sons: 4 x 14 = 56 Daughter: 1 x 07 = 07 Total 72 shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
